summary: North Olympic Library System urges continued E‑Rate funding, emphasizing cybersecurity needs, essential community services, and local control of safety policies. The comment strongly supports continued E‑Rate funding, opposes federal mandates on screen‑time and privacy, and endorses the use of consultants.
